purpose: Additive source/access/requirement/crosswalk data for direct-source IEEE review and SDOS runtime-governance intake. Crosswalks remain derivative and cannot assert source wording or Caelestis conformity.

reference_document.title: SDOS Runtime Governance Framework — Control Catalog and Reference Document

focal_document.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

provenance_notes: NIST OLIR identifies this Final owner-authored informative reference as mapping SDOS v1.7 to NIST AI RMF 1.0 with a supportive, non-equivalent relationship.
NIST states that 49 AI RMF subcategories are mapped; the full row-level submission was not ingested in this work package.
The current SDOS primary source is v1.10. This v1.7 crosswalk is retained as version-bounded derivative evidence and must not be silently applied to later SDOS versions.

The live AAM SDOS page currently labels the AI RMF OLIR as Reference ID 220, while the NIST OLIR catalogue exposes the Final record at Reference ID 212. VIGIL treats the NIST catalogue as authoritative for OLIR record identity.
